title: Graphic issue with printed Surface..
content:
Hi,  
I'm trying to add a graphic on a printed surface.. But the graphic appears underneath the print.. I even try to bring the graphic to front.. But still it is underneath the print.. Can you please clarify why this is happeing and how to resolve this issue..   
I've attached an image from which you can better understand what I'm actually meaning...  
  
Thank You!..

Reply 2: There is no need to uninstall and reinstall CLO as suggested below. First, we should determine if the issue is file-specific or not. If it's only happening for you on this file and you cannot replicate the problem on another, we can have a look at it. If it is all files, we must investigate with tech support.

But the solution I found is just to increase the z-offset value of the graphic to make it on front.. But I don't think it is a good technique to make it visible on upfront.. Bcz May be in render it will be floating in the air.. But this is the only solution I've in my mind right now..
Reply 4: Hi, could you share one of your files here (upload it to wetransfer and add the link into your message) and note you are coming from the community and it is for Melody? Thank you! https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/1653acfd9cb74b23b2754fae6a92f84e

"the print of fabric" shows at the top of everything!If you add the pink graphic on the fabric, you should add leopard as texture of fabric.I'm sorry about I couldn't understand well, and as Im a Korean, my English explain is not well.Good luck!

Reply 3: Hi Claude, sorry I do not understand what you mean. If you could make a separate thread for the issue so you can add a screenshot, that would be great!
Reply 4: First I'm sorry about making confusion. There are mistake in my studying. The print is just on the top of fabric texture, not the graphic.Second maybe I found the reason why the letter "pink" is appeared. You can see another letter "pink" on the middle left. I think the letters exist on the leopard picture. Is it right?
Reply 5: Claude Evelyn you are right the leapord print itself has pink letter in it.. But if you see at the wasitband bottom there is a "PINK" letter seprately which I tried to add as a Graphic not as a print.. And it appears on the bottom of the print.. This is the actual issue which I want to raise.. :) I actually always add print as a texture I just tried that add print option first time.. I got stuck.. Lol.. :)
Reply 6: Looking at print1 in the fabric properties window, it looks like the black leopard pattern was insert as a print without a background. How about adding some color(brown) to the leopard print background and layering it with fabric texture? .But It's still weird how the pink text appears due to the print insertion. lolOne solution might be to completely delete the program and download it again. GOOD LUCK!

Comment 3: I don't know how you add the graphic.Use the "graphic (2D pattern)"and move the graphic, using the "graphic switch(변환)" which is above the first one.If your question mean is the graphic is appear on the background, click the graphic with "graphic switch(변환)" and check property -> arrangement -> surface.
Reply 1: HI,, Thank You for your response.. I actually mean.. the graphic "PINK" is under the leopard like print.. if you see the image.. I tried to Select the graphic in 2D window.. and Order 2D> Bring to Front but it still under the print..
Reply 2: The red box on the right show that your "pink" graphic is added as "print of fabric". As I know, showing as unified can't move.. Graphic should show on the "pixelate icon" next to the fabric icon. https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/1653acfd9cb74b23b2754fae6a92f84e
Reply 3: Actually the Leapord print is added as a "print of Fabric".. And "PINK" Graphic is added as a Graphic tool.. which one is behind the print of Fabric.. I want that "Pink" Graphic to be on front.. As you see leapord print is on front which is wrong...

Reply 5: Sorry.. May be I'm not able to explain it properly.. But I think you misunderstood the "PINK" with the color.. But "PINK" is not a color actually it is a Graphic Typo which is named as "PINK" if you see in the 3D Window.. "PINK" TEXT is under the Leapord pirnt just where the waistband ends.. I want that "PINK" Text in front.. May be this explain you better what I'm actually looking for.. Thank YOu!

title: [Design Contest] K-Pop Mirror: Recreate Your Favorite Styles!
content:
# **_Interested in K-pop? Here's your chance! 🥳_**

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202502/e2e20d7431824713b78357efcc137f2c/images/a08dcd7c17934d4587b635cf7934510aCONNECT_News%20Letter.png)

Join our **"K-pop Mirror: Recreate Your Favorite Styles!"** contest and recreate the outfit of your favorite K-pop stars exactly as it is!  
It’s the perfect opportunity to challenge yourself by perfectly recreating an iconic idol outfit. 💃🕺

## ** _The Stage is Yours, Join Now!_**

# **📌 Contest Details**

  * 👗 Theme: Choose your favorite K-Pop stars and recreate their outfits with precision.

  * 🎨 Who Can Join: Anyone!

  * 📅 Submission Period: February 25 – April 07, 2025

  * 🏆 Winner Announcement: April 22, 2025

  * ❓ Want to know more? Just follow this [**[LINK]**](https://connect.clo-set.com/contest/k-popmirror)**!**




# **🎁 Prizes (You don’t want to miss this!)**

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202502/e2e20d7431824713b78357efcc137f2c/images/cf30de30cc114d469173fcf8a7618a0f20250205_172143.png)

🏅 When the total number of submissions goes over 300, all winners' rewards will be doubled! The more contestants, the more rewards you'll get!

# **🧵 How to Enter (Super Easy!)**

  1. Create a **perfect replica** of the idol outfit.

  2. Click the **[SUBMIT]** button on the contest page to upload your file and then submit the image you used as a reference for your creation as an additional image. 

  3. Wait excitedly for the results! (This might be the hardest part! 😉)




  


# **📌 For more details & to enter, visit **[**[HERE]**](https://connect.clo-set.com/contest/k-popmirror)**!**

If you have any questions, feel free to ask in the comments, on the Q&A board, or through our [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/closet_connect_official/).

**With passion** 🔥**,**  
**The CONNECT Team**

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202502/e2e20d7431824713b78357efcc137f2c/images/2446234f9c0847968862b4dfcf97fb78CONNECT_News%20Letter.png)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202502/e2e20d7431824713b78357efcc137f2c/images/76e0105c22b44fcca6fa581c01a56b5fsquare.png)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202502/e2e20d7431824713b78357efcc137f2c/images/8f9d8c02e0434693a40a58451c732f29square.png)

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi🙂Can I use 3ds max software for material/texture and rendering? I mean, use clo3d only for create 3d modeling.
Reply 1: Hello, As mentioned in the participation guidelines, you are free to use other tools, but please make sure to use CLO3D or Marvelous Designer for outfit creation.🙏🏻For more details, please check the page below and attached image.Link: https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/e2e20d7431824713b78357efcc137f2c

Comment 2: Hi Team, Does the reference image need to be recreated exactly the same? I mean, not just the outfit but also the pose? Will this be a factor in the evaluation? Or is the focus more on the execution of the outfit? Thanks! 🙏🏻
Reply 1: While it's ideal if the pose matches the reference image, the main evaluation criteria focus on how accurately the outfit is recreated exactly. So, while the pose can enhance the overall presentation, the primary factor in judging will be the execution of the outfit itself.Hope this helps! Let me know if you have any other questions. Looking forward to seeing your work!❤️

Comment 3: I live in Mexico. Can I participate in the contest? 😊✨
Reply 1: Of course! This contest is open worldwide!✨

Comment 4: Multiple entries allowed, maximum of ten (10) submissions per contestant.is that mean you can submit 10 different looks ?
Reply 1: Thank you for your interest.😊 Yes, you can submit a minimum of 1 and a maximum of 10 different outfits.

Comment 5: Hi, do I understand correctly that the selected garment needs to be recreated in 3D as accurately as possible?
Reply 1: Yes, that's correct! Please try to replicate it as closely as possible to the real thing! 😊
content_description: Join the "K-pop Mirror: Recreate Your Favorite Styles!" contest to showcase your creativity by perfectly replicating the iconic outfits of your favorite K-pop stars!
